humanTitle: People lose their place, and their work, when the editor freezes
whoItAffects: iPhone, iPad and Android users, across six app versions rather than one bad release.

build.proposition: An editor that keeps your text when the app stops responding.
specifics: Write each keystroke to local storage, not only on save
Restore the caret and scroll position after a forced restart
Start with the close-and-reopen path reviewers keep describing
build.limitation: A mobile OS can kill a backgrounded app before it finishes writing anything to disk.

start.proposition: A recovery layer that editors could license rather than build.
specifics: Capture edits below the app, at the input layer
Sell to the teams shipping editors, not to the people typing
start.limitation: The apps losing the work are the ones who would have to buy it, and they already believe their sync works.

study.proposition: How much writing is actually lost, and does anyone notice at the time?
specifics: Instrument a real editor and compare keystrokes typed against keystrokes persisted
Ask whether people who lose work switch tools or simply repeat it
study.limitation: The apps holding this data will not share it, and self-reported loss is unreliable.

write.proposition: Why the little saved indicator lies.
specifics: Trace what saved means across three editors people trust
Open on the reviews describing a restart every few minutes
write.limitation: Autosave failure is well-trodden ground; the fresh angle is the gap between the indicator and the truth.
